unstuck_said.text: Filed additive issue #2 on hive-autogen-actor repo (github.com/srotzin/hive-autogen-actor/issues/2): proposed a Nano (XNO) settlement hook beside Hive that fires on each AutoGen tool invocation, paired with nano-invoice (dhyabi2/nano-invoice) to bind a received payment to the specific tool call (Nano has no memo field). Framed in the targets own terms: the actor exposes the invoice and checks settlement the same way it registers a tool call against Hive; Hive stays default, Nano opt-in. Saying plainly the tool is ours.
